SRSNAME=urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::3857 returned EPSG:3857; the anchor landed 2.7939677238464355e-09 m from the pyproj reference (limit 0.01 m).

WFS exposed the namespaced field as 'eo_x003A_cloud_cover' (GML escapes ':' as _x003A_) with 9 populated values, e.g. [5.0, 8.0, 25.0]. The identical field is missing from every OGC API Features / FeatureServer payload - see NB-GPD-SCH-01 on the ogc-features envelope.
objectid dtype=int32, count=int32, ratio=float64, active=bool, created_at=datetime64[ms, UTC], event_date=datetime64[ms]; every shared declared scalar dtype matches OGC API Features.

created_at=Timestamp('2024-01-01 12:00:00'), event_date=datetime.date(2024, 2, 1), event_time=datetime.time(12, 34, 56) - the declared xsd:dateTime/xsd:date/xsd:time types survived Arrow conversion and all values match the seeded instants.
10 features returned with 1 nil geometry; the server emits the nillable geometry property rather than dropping the feature or writing an empty gml:Point.
4 pages of COUNT=3 produced 10 distinct features with no repeats and no gaps.
COUNT=1000000 returned 10 features (clamped, not rejected); STARTINDEX=10000 returned an empty FeatureCollection rather than a service exception.
GDAL satisfies GetFeatureCount with GetFeature&RESULTTYPE=hits (fast_feature_count=True) and the server reported numberMatched=10, matching the seeded row count without transferring features.
PROPERTYNAME=name,status produced exactly ['name', 'status'] on 3 features; no unrequested property was serialized.

BBOX in urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 lat/lon order matched 3 features; the same numbers supplied in lon/lat order yielded HTTP 400, proving the server applies the CRS-declared axis order instead of guessing.
fes:PropertyIsEqualTo(status, 'active') returned 5 features, all with status='active', so the server evaluates OGC Filter Encoding 2.0 predicates.

Client-observed statuses: {'unknown-typename': '400', 'malformed-srsname': '400'}. The unknown-typename response body was a well-formed ows:ExceptionReport, so a GeoPandas caller receives a diagnosable failure instead of an empty document.

10 unique gml:id values (e.g. ['pub-test-service-feature-0.1', 'pub-test-service-feature-0.2', 'pub-test-service-feature-0.3']), identical across two requests and each suffixed with the feature's objectid, so a client can key on them across pages.
GeoPackage round trip preserved 10 features, EPSG:4326, the objectid ordering and the null geometry, with a worst deviation of 0.0 deg.
